data.summary: Probed http://127.0.0.1:3010 (OWASP Juice Shop v20.1.1) and discovered 20+ API endpoints. Key findings: (1) SQL injection in /rest/products/search?q= (SQLite, UNION SELECT confirmed, extracted user credentials & table schemas); (2) Path traversal in /ftp/ via %2500.md null byte bypass allowing download of forbidden file types (.bak, .pyc, .kdbx, .yml); (3) User data exposure via /rest/memories/ (returns password hashes, emails, roles without auth); (4) Stored XSS in /rest/products/1/reviews (pre-existing XSS payloads visible); (5) Public configuration exposure via /rest/admin/application-configuration; (6) Directory listing on /ftp/ exposing sensitive files including coupons, encrypted announcements, package.json.bak, suspicious_errors.yml, incident-support.kdbx, encrypt.pyc and order PDFs.

candidates.title: SQL Injection in product search endpoint
candidates.claim: SQL injection allows extraction of all database contents including user credentials
candidates.poc_hint: Send GET request to /rest/products/search?q=test')) UNION SELECT 1,email,password,4,5,6,7,8,9 FROM Users--. Observe that the response returns all user emails in the 'name' field and password hashes in the 'description' field. The table has 9 columns as confirmed by UNION SELECT 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9.

candidates.title: Path traversal in FTP file server via null byte injection
candidates.claim: Null byte injection bypasses file extension whitelist allowing download of any file
candidates.proof_excerpt:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/octet-stream
...
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<kdbx>... (KeePass database file incident-support.kdbx downloaded)
candidates.poc_hint: Send GET to /ftp/coupons_2013.md.bak%2500.md (double URL-encoded null byte + '.md' stub). The response returns the .bak file contents with Content-Type: application/octet-stream, bypassing the 'Only .md and .pdf files are allowed' filter.

candidates.title: User data exposure via /rest/memories/ endpoint
candidates.claim: Unauthenticated endpoint returns user details including password hashes
candidates.poc_hint: Send GET request to /rest/memories/ without any authentication. Response contains nested User objects with email, password hash, role, and deluxeToken for each memory entry.

candidates.title: Stored XSS in product reviews
candidates.claim: Persistent XSS payloads are stored in product reviews and will execute when rendered
candidates.poc_hint: Send GET to /rest/products/1/reviews. Observe that multiple XSS payloads are already stored: , , . These execute when the review is rendered in the frontend.

candidates.title: Public exposure of application configuration
candidates.claim: Sensitive application configuration including OAuth client ID and challenge config is publicly accessible
candidates.poc_hint: Send GET request to /rest/admin/application-configuration. The response contains OAuth client IDs, server config, social media URLs, Google OAuth redirect URIs, challenge configuration, and more.

candidates.title: Directory listing on /ftp/ exposes sensitive files
candidates.claim: The /ftp/ directory has directory listing enabled, exposing internal files
candidates.poc_hint: Send GET to /ftp/. Directory listing is enabled and reveals files including acquisitions.md, coupons_2013.md.bak, incident-support.kdbx (KeePass DB), package.json.bak, suspicious_errors.yml, encrypt.pyc, and order PDFs.

facts.summary: SQL injection confirmed in /rest/products/search?q= endpoint (SQLite, 9 columns, UNION SELECT)
Path traversal in /ftp/ via %2500.md null byte bypass allowing download of forbidden file types
User data exposure via /rest/memories/ - returns password hashes, emails, roles without authentication

deadends: /api/Users requires valid JWT Authorization header - cannot enumerate without auth token
/api/BasketItems requires authentication - cannot access without session
/b2b/v2/orders requires valid bearer JWT token - injected test token rejected with 'Invalid token: no header in signature'
/rest/user/change-password is not a valid endpoint (returns 500 Unexpected path)
/rest/user/reset-password is rate-limited (100 requests) and requires correct security answer
